Agentic RL: Designing agentic reinforcement learning and reasoning strategies that improve planning, reflection, and multi-step decision making for intelligent agents.
Studying how LLMs can iteratively think, critique, and act in complex environments through self-correction and long-horizon interaction.
Integrating reinforcement learning and feedback-driven alignment to improve robustness, usefulness, and task-level performance.
LLM/MLLM Reasoning: Advancing LLM and MLLM reasoning for tool use, perception-aware planning, and complex problem solving.
Developing models that connect language, vision, and structured context for grounded reasoning in open-ended environments.
Exploring chain-of-thought, test-time scaling, and reasoning augmentation for embodied and real-world tasks.
Efficient LLM: Designing efficient adaptation strategies for large models, including PEFT, prompt tuning, and low-rank fine-tuning.
Improving deployment efficiency through lightweight adaptation, task specialization, and compute-aware model design.
Supporting practical LLM usage in resource-constrained settings such as edge intelligence, robotics, and domain-specific applications.

Image/Video Generation: Designing generative models that synthesize plausible future worlds and enrich the predictive capacity of intelligent agents.

Studying controllable image and video generation from structured conditions, as well as generative image restoration, by leveraging generative foundation models such as Stable Diffusion and FLUX for world simulation and future prediction.
Supporting scene completion, what-if reasoning, and foresightful planning by generating realistic observations beyond what is directly seen.
3D/4D Reconstruction & Editing: Studying 3D and 4D reconstruction from sparse, multi-view, or partially observed inputs for dynamic scene understanding and spatial intelligence.
Building editable world representations that support view synthesis, geometry-aware manipulation, and temporal consistency with 3D foundation models such as VGGT.
Connecting reconstruction and editing with world modeling to enable controllable spatial understanding, simulation, and interactive content creation.

Collaborative Perception: Designing collaborative perception and multi-agent scene understanding methods for embodied agents and autonomous vehicles in complex environments.
Overcoming occlusion, limited sensing range, and communication constraints through cooperative visual and multimodal perception.
Studying robust and secure collaboration mechanisms for perception, reasoning, and decision making in real-world deployments.
UAV Delivery: Developing intelligent UAV systems for delivery, inspection, and autonomous mission execution in smart-city environments.
Studying UGV-UAV collaboration, task coordination, and low-altitude autonomy for logistics and urban services.
Integrating perception, navigation, and scheduling for reliable autonomous systems under dynamic operating conditions.
Integrated Air-Ground Design: Exploring integrated air-ground architectures for sensing, communication, computing, and control in low-altitude economy applications.
Leveraging aerial and ground resources jointly to support smart mobility, traffic management, and responsive urban services.
Designing system-level frameworks that connect embodied intelligence with smart-city infrastructure and future air-ground ecosystems.

Multimodal Health Monitoring: Developing multimodal health monitoring systems that integrate physiological, visual, audio, and environmental signals for smart healthcare.
Studying remote and outdoor health sensing for elderly care, chronic disease monitoring, and public-health support.
Exploring non-invasive monitoring technologies such as camera-based sensing and wireless physiological measurement.
Wireless Sensing for Public Safety: Using wireless sensing and AI to monitor public environments for safety, anomaly detection, and rapid risk awareness.
Designing privacy-preserving sensing systems that support public safety without relying on intrusive visual surveillance alone.
Extending intelligent sensing to applications such as hazard detection, crowd safety, and resilient security monitoring.

Edge AI: Investigating edge AI systems that jointly optimize communication, sensing, and computation for intelligent applications.
Supporting distributed inference, collaborative learning, and task offloading across vehicles, UAVs, and mobile devices.
Designing resource-aware architectures for practical deployment of intelligent networking systems.
Computing Power Networks: Studying computing power networks that flexibly coordinate heterogeneous compute resources over dynamic wireless infrastructure.
Leveraging mobile platforms and networked intelligence to provide task-oriented computing services on demand.
Connecting communications, scheduling, and resource orchestration for future smart-city and autonomous-system workloads.
Smart Surface: Designing smart surfaces and RIS-enabled wireless systems for robust, adaptive, and high-efficiency communications.
Exploring semantic communication, fast V2I/V2X links, and intelligent signal processing in challenging environments.
Advancing low-power IoT communication, backscatter systems, and emerging smart-surface-assisted networking paradigms.

Adversarial Attack and Defense: Studying adversarial attacks and defenses for collaborative perception, embodied intelligence, and multimodal AI systems.
Analyzing robustness under malicious perturbations, distribution shifts, and adversarial interaction settings.
Designing defense mechanisms that preserve reliability, safety, and trustworthy deployment in real-world AI pipelines.
Model Watermarking: Developing secure model watermarking techniques for AI intellectual property protection, especially for generative models.
Studying robustness, fidelity, and resistance to removal attacks in practical white-box and black-box settings.
Exploring trustworthy ownership verification for modern foundation models and AIGC systems.
AIGC Forensics: Exploring AIGC forensics for synthetic image, video, and model output analysis in security-sensitive settings.
Studying data privacy, provenance, and tamper detection for trustworthy AI-generated content.
Connecting forensic analysis with privacy-preserving data transactions and secure AI deployment.
